approved.en: Russian drone strikes hit a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13, and Russian attacks have cut power to thousands as the Kherson ceasefire ends. In the occupied city of Oleshky a localized cease-fire entered its third day, allowing evacuations but aid vehicles continue to be attacked. Ukrainian forces reported a strike on a Russian rocket fuel factory and a missile launcher system. The Kyiv Independent recorded Russian attacks that killed 1 person and injured 47, leaving hundreds of thousands without electricity. The conflict accounted for 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have prolonged the siege of Hebron into a tenth day, arresting residents and warning of a wider offensive in the West Bank. UN rights officials have warned that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare. Israeli air strikes across Gaza have killed eight civilians, including a child, and caused severe trauma among hospital staff. Settlers attacked a West Bank town, wounding three olive harvesters and leaving a mother living in fear of her son’s killer. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske luftangrep over Gaza har drept åtte sivile, inkludert et barn, og forårsaket alvorlig traume blant sykehuspersonell. Bosettere angrep en by på Vestbredden, såret tre olivenplukkere og etterlot en mor som lever i frykt for sin sønns drapsmann. Konflikten førte til 21 440 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israel reported a controlled detonation of a strike in southern Lebanon, and Lebanese military courts have charged 13 individuals over a seized Hezbollah explosives truck. Lebanon has charged 13 people for confiscated Hezbollah explosives, reflecting heightened security actions. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding for the south. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces reported three tankers ablaze and mines striking four tankers in the Strait of Hormuz while Iran's foreign minister welcomed U.S. outreach during a Qatari mediation visit. Iran's supreme leader ordered the military to expand retaliation plans without geographic limits and the security chief debated discarding the nuclear weapons ban. Iranian envoys met Qatari mediators as the United States threatened strikes after the midterm elections, and Iran's strikes on U.S. Middle East bases disabled early-warning systems. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Irans øverste leder beordret militæret til å utvide gjengjeldelsesplanene uten geografiske begrensninger, og sikkerhetslederen diskuterte å forkaste forbudet mot atomvåpen. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Syria is actively pursuing security cooperation, with its foreign minister confirming talks on joining the Mecca defence pact and officials arresting suspected ISIS members linked to assassinations in Deir Ezzor. Jordan is engaging militarily, stopping an armed group attempting entry from Syria, striking terrorists in retaliation for a church attack, and intercepting millions of drug pills at the Syrian border. Damascus is also expanding diplomatic outreach, participating in Cairo Water Week to discuss agricultural and water cooperation, while seizing large quantities of Captagon and dismantling drug networks. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Jordan deltar militært, stopper en væpnet gruppe som forsøkte å komme inn fra Syria, slår ned på terrorister som gjengjeldelse for et kirkebombardement, og avskjærer millioner av narkotika-piller ved grensen mot Syria. Damaskus utvider også diplomatisk kontakt, deltar i Kairo vannuke for å diskutere landbruks‑ og vannsamarbeid, samtidig som de beslaglegger store mengder Captagon og avvikler narkotikamiljøer. approved.en: RSF drone strikes have hit Nyala market, killing 102 civilians and injuring 113, and have set oil facilities ablaze in eastern Sudan while also knocking out power stations in northern Sudan. A senior RSF commander defected and joined the national army, accusing RSF leadership of nepotism. Sudan's cabinet placed the country on maximum alert after RSF drone attacks on power infrastructure, and bakeries in Khartoum have closed due to severe flour and power shortages as the army and RSF wage a silent economic war. Sudan General Al-Atta accused Puntland mercenaries of fighting alongside RSF, and Burhan, Abiy and Afwerki met in Moscow to discuss Russia's interests in the Horn of Africa. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En høytstående RSF-kommandør har gått over til den sudanske hæren og anklaget RSF-ledelsen for nepotisme. Sudans regjering har satt landet på maksimal beredskap etter RSF-droneangrep på kraftinfrastruktur, og bakerier i Khartoum har stengt på grunn av alvorlige mel‑ og strøm­mangel mens hæren og RSF fører en stille økonomisk krig. General Al-Atta i hæren anklaget Puntland-leiesoldater for å kjempe sammen med RSF, og Burhan, Abiy og Afwerki møttes i Moskva for å diskutere Russlands interesser i Afrikas horn. 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In Abyei, a market was hit by a drone strike that killed 73 people, and another drone attack in the disputed region killed 153, according to officials. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP. UN Secretary-General Guterres condemned the escalation of drone attacks, and the deputy minister of ICT warned against abusing freedom of expression.

approved.en: Al-Shabaab and ISIS continue fighting Somali army forces in central and southern Somalia, while Mawisley militias have withdrawn from front lines and Puntland mercenaries are reported fighting alongside RSF. Uganda and Ethiopia are pulling their troops out after years of deployment, and the African Union is withdrawing from four Lower Shabelle bases, while the UN political mission ends after three decades. The UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year, and Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel, rescuing seven Pakistani crew. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Uganda og Etiopia trekker sine tropper ut etter flere år med utplassering, og Den afrikanske unionen trekker seg tilbake fra fire baser i Lower Shabelle, mens FN-s politiske oppdrag avsluttes etter tre tiår. De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneangrep mot al-Shabaab på nesten ett år, og somaliske pirater tok en iransk fiskefartøy, og reddet syv pakistanske mannskap. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen killed a soldier and stole a rifle at a Plateau checkpoint while bandits killed a security guard and abducted a woman in Kebbi. In Plateau, a 16-year-old herder was killed and houses were razed, and elsewhere gunmen killed a soldier and stole two weapons at another checkpoint. ISWAP leaders and a shura council member were killed by troops in Borno, and police rescued 11 abducted women and farmers across six states. A dozen children were kidnapped in central Nigeria and an AAC youth leader accused politicians of using poor youths to attack Sowore. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Våpenbærende menn drepte en soldat og stjal et gevær ved en sjekkpost i Plateau, mens banditter drepte en sikkerhetsvakt og bortførte en kvinne i Kebbi. I Plateau ble en 16‑år gammel hyrde drept og hus ble brent ned, og andre steder drepte væpnede menn en soldat og stjal to våpen ved en annen sjekkpost. ISWAP-ledere og et medlem av shura-rådet ble drept av tropper i Borno, og politiet reddet 11 bortførte kvinner og bønder i seks delstater. Et dusin barn ble kidnappet i sentrale Nigeria, og en ungdomsleder i AAC anklaget politikere for å bruke fattige ungdommer til å angripe Sowore. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Joseph Kabila, the former president, now leads a rebel coalition that includes the M23 movement and is attacking Congolese government forces in eastern DRC. Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama have been sanctioned by the United States for supplying the rebels, while the FRN reported that rebel forces captured several positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting. Ebola workers have struck in the Congo as the outbreak exceeds 5,000 deaths, prompting WHO warnings of a continent-wide spread. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The government has expanded its BIR rapid-intervention force around Lake Chad and is deploying drones and joint border patrols to target Anglophone separatists in the Northwest and Southwest, where attacks on troops continue. Government troops killed four suspected separatists after a deadly village attack and suspended Issa Tchiroma’s political party for three months. An army vehicle hit a landmine near the Cameroon border, killing eight soldiers, and attacks on police and government sites in Fundong injured three people. 231 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Trump refererte til operasjonen for å fange Maduro mens han snakket om Cuba, foreslo mulig amerikansk handling mot Cuba, og hevdet at inntektene fra venezuelansk olje langt overgår kostnadene ved krigen i Iran. Chevron utvider virksomheten i Venezuela mens Exxon oppfordrer til forsiktighet. To dødsfall i kamp i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
